description: Vite build optimizations in artifacts/electron/vite.config.ts: add modulePreload polyfill, split framer-motion/motion into its own vendor chunk, add react-vendor chunk, set explicit build targets. The build already has map-vendor (maplibre-gl), graphics-vendor (ogl, three), and motion-vendor (gsap). Need to add: react-vendor (react, react-dom), framer-vendor (framer-motion, motion). Enable cssCodeSplit explicitly and set build.target to es2020 for modern tree-shaking.
steps: 1. Read /projects/sandbox/electron/artifacts/electron/vite.config.ts. Note current manualChunks: map-vendor (maplibre-gl), graphics-vendor (ogl + three), motion-vendor (gsap). Note there is no react-vendor or framer-vendor chunk.

2. In the manualChunks function, add before the existing checks:
- Add react-vendor: `if (id.includes('node_modules/react') && !id.includes('node_modules/react-dom')) return 'react-vendor';` Wait, use: `if (id.includes('/node_modules/react/') || id.includes('/node_modules/react-dom/') || id.includes('/node_modules/react-dom')) return 'react-vendor';`
- Add framer-vendor: `if (id.includes('node_modules/framer-motion') || id.includes('node_modules/motion')) return 'framer-vendor';`
- Keep existing: map-vendor, graphics-vendor, motion-vendor (gsap).
3. Add `modulePreload: { polyfill: true }` to the build section (inside build: { ... }) to ensure modulepreload links work cross-browser.
4. Add `target: 'es2020'` and `cssCodeSplit: true` to the build section for better tree-shaking and CSS chunking.

5. Run `PORT=5000 BASE_PATH=/ npx vite build --config vite.config.ts` from /projects/sandbox/electron/artifacts/electron to verify the build succeeds. Check the output for the new react-vendor and framer-vendor chunks.
6. Run pnpm run typecheck from /projects/sandbox/electron to confirm no TypeScript errors.
acceptance_criteria: artifacts/electron/vite.config.ts manualChunks includes react-vendor and framer-vendor chunks
modulePreload polyfill is enabled in build options
PORT=5000 BASE_PATH=/ npx vite build from artifacts/electron succeeds
verification: PORT=5000 BASE_PATH=/ npx vite build from /projects/sandbox/electron/artifacts/electron - check for react-vendor and framer-vendor in dist/public/assets/
findings: Build succeeded. New chunks: react-vendor-DNOV3Zvc.js (185.87 kB raw / 58.57 kB gzip), framer-vendor-CMPH8L7y.js (122.69 kB raw / 40.03 kB gzip). Existing chunks retained: map-vendor, graphics-vendor (59.86 kB), motion-vendor (70.12 kB). modulePreload polyfill, target es2020, and cssCodeSplit all applied. pnpm typecheck failure for dom-chromium-installation-events is pre-existing (fails on base commit too).
